newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yield flat on Bulgaria 1-wk T-bills, rises on 4-wk.
newsitem.headline: Yield flat on Bulgaria 1-wk T-bills, rises on 4-wk.

text.p: The yield was unchanged at Wednesday's auction of Bulgarian finance ministry one-week discount T-bills but it rose on four-week discount government securities, central bank figures showed.
Average yields to maturity on the two issues were 1.58 and 5.51 percent, respectively, compared with 1.58 percent and 5.32 percent on Monday.
Bids were received for a total of 49.362 billion levs of T-bills for today's auctions but the ministry approved bids for 43.262 billion levs.
The issues were offered with par values of 20 billion levs and 45 billion levs, respectively and no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 20,000 million levs 45,000 million levs
Bids received 9,570 million levs 39,791.5 million levs
Bids approved 7,470 million levs 35,791.5 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 1.58 pct 5.51 pct
